paragraphs.translation: 孩子們上週參觀了香港科學博物館的展覽。 閱讀關於展覽和孩子們所說的話的宣傳冊。

sentences.text: Let's see an exhibition during the vacation.
sentences.translation: 讓我們在假期期間去看展覽。

sentences.text: Each illustration comes with a caption.

sentences.text: Wow! 'Fun station' is a fascinating invention.
sentences.translation:
哇！'趣味站' 是一個迷人的發明。



說明：Fun Station 通常是互動式的娛樂 + 科普裝置; 特點是「有趣（Fun）」—— 比如可以讓人體驗趣味科學、遊戲化學習的設備（例如結合遊戲的科學實驗台、互動遊樂裝置等），既能帶來樂趣，也屬於創新的發明設計。

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.text:
Amy Ho likes high-tech toys, doo-dah, doo-dah.
She plays them with girls and boys, h-de-doo-dah-day.
She plays games on her mobile phone, doo-dah, doo-dah.
She doesn't like to play alone, h-de-doo-dah-day.
lyrics.explanation: 歌詞講解： 第一段歌詞介紹 Amy Ho 喜歡高科技玩具，和男孩女孩們一起玩。她在手機上玩遊戲，不喜歡獨自玩。doo-dah, doo-dah 是歌曲中的節奏襯詞。

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.text:
She plays with her friends Ray, Mike and Kate.
They like playing video games together at weekends.
lyrics.explanation: 歌詞講解： 副歌部分描述 Amy 和她的朋友們 Ray、Mike 和 Kate 一起玩，他們喜歡在週末一起玩電子遊戲。

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.text:
She showed Grandpa her MP3, doo-dah, doo-dah.
Her favourite song is Do-re-mi, oh-de-doo-dah-day.
Grandpa likes the record player, doo-dah, doo-dah.
Tech toys make his hair go greyer, oh-de-doo-dah-day.
lyrics.explanation: 歌詞講解： 第二段歌詞對比了不同世代的科技產品。Amy 向爺爺展示她的 MP3 播放器（現代科技），而爺爺則喜歡唱片播放機（舊科技）。"Tech toys make his hair go greyer" 是一個幽默的說法，意思是這些科技玩具讓爺爺感到困惑或老化。

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.text:
She plays with her friends Ray, Mike and Kate.
They like playing video games together at weekends.
lyrics.explanation: 歌詞講解： 重複的副歌完整了歌曲結構，強調了歌曲的主題：科技玩具的樂趣和友誼。

questions.question: 1. How many verses are there in the song?
questions.answer: There are two verses in the song.
questions.explanation: 歌曲共有兩段主歌（Verse 1 和 Verse 2），加上重複出現的副歌（Chorus），所以答案是 There are two verses in the song。

questions.question: 2. "Player" rhymes with "greyer". Find three more pairs of rhyming words in the lyrics.
questions.answer: boys - joys, phone - alone, Kate - great
questions.explanation: 歌詞中的押韻組合包括 boys - joys、phone - alone、Kate - great，另外也有 player - greyer 一組。

questions.question: 3. What does Amy like to play on her mobile phone?
questions.answer: She likes to play games on her mobile phone.
questions.explanation: 歌詞說 She plays games on her mobile phone，Amy 喜歡在手機上玩遊戲。

questions.question: 4. What does Grandpa like to use to listen to music?
questions.answer: He likes to use a record player to listen to music.
questions.explanation: 歌詞說 Grandpa likes the record player，爺爺喜歡用唱片播放機聽音樂。

practice.intro: 根據單元5內容完成以下練習題：

factOpinion.title: 練習 1：事實與觀點辨析題
factOpinion.description: 判斷下列句子屬於事實（Fact）還是觀點（Opinion），點擊對應的方框：

statements.text: 1. Amy and her classmates visited the Hong Kong Science Museum last week.
statements.explanation: 這是一項事實：課文第一句提到孩子們上週參觀了香港科學博物館的展覽，可以在課文中找到證據。

statements.text: 2. Old cameras are better than digital cameras.
statements.explanation: 這是一個觀點：『舊相機比數位相機更好』是 Amy 奶奶個人的看法，不同的人可能有不同的想法，無法用事實證明。

statements.text: 3. Andy's grandpa's old TV set was a gift from his father.
statements.explanation: 這是一項事實：課文中 Andy 說那台電視機是他爸爸送的禮物，可以在課文中找到證據。

statements.text: 4. People can use both typewriters and computers to type letters and stories.
statements.explanation: 這是一項事實：課文中 Ray 說過既可以用打字機也可以用電腦來打信件和故事。

statements.text: 5. The old songs Amy's parents listen to are quite pleasant to the ears.
statements.explanation: 這是一個觀點：『那些老歌很悅耳』是 Amy 父母個人的感受，屬於主觀的看法，無法用事實證明。

vocabMatching.title: 練習 2：詞彙匹配題
vocabMatching.description: 將下列單字與正確的釋義匹配：

questions.text: 1. modern
questions.explanation: modern 的意思是『現代的』，即「新的、跟上時代的」，所以對應 C. new, up-to-date。

questions.text: 2. awesome
questions.explanation: awesome 的意思是『厲害的、很棒的』，形容非常好、令人讚嘆的事物，所以對應 A. nice, great。

questions.text: 3. pleasant
questions.explanation: pleasant 的意思是『悅耳的、令人愉快的』，形容令人舒服愉悅的事物，所以對應 B. enjoyable, easy to like。

readingComp.title: 練習 3：閱讀理解選擇題
readingComp.description: 根據課文內容，選擇最佳答案：

questions.text: 1. What kind of exhibition did the children visit?
questions.explanation: 課文第一句說 The children visited an exhibition at the Hong Kong Science Museum，孩子們參觀的是科技產品展覽（gadget exhibition），所以選 C。

questions.text: 2. Which of the following is true about Amy's grandma?

options.text: A. She doesn't like taking pictures.
B. She still uses her old camera.
C. She thinks digital cameras are better.
D. She bought a new camera from the museum.

questions.explanation: 課文中 Amy 說 She still uses it，她的奶奶仍然在使用她的舊相機，所以選 B。

questions.text: 3. Why doesn't Andy's grandpa want to buy a new TV set?

options.text: A. The old TV set is cheap.
B. The old TV set has good picture quality.
C. The old TV set was a gift from his dad.
D. He doesn't like new gadgets.

questions.explanation: Andy 說 It's all because the TV set was a gift from his dad，爺爺不換新電視是因為舊電視機是爸爸送的禮物，所以選 C。

questions.text: 4. What does Ray think about old and new things?

options.text: A. Old things are worse than new ones.
B. New things are the best.
C. Both old and new things have their value.
D. He only likes modern gadgets.

questions.explanation: Ray 說 I like both the old things and the new things，他認為新舊事物都有價值，所以選 C。

questions.text: 5. Which of the following is NOT a gadget mentioned in the text for taking pictures?
questions.explanation: 課文中提到拍照的器材有 film camera（膠片相機）、digital camera（數位相機），手機也可以用來拍照；typewriter（打字機）是用來打字的，不是拍照工具，所以選 D。

questions.text: 6. What does Ray say about old and new things?

options.text: A. The newest things are the best.
B. Old machines are worse than new gadgets.
C. I like both the old things and the new things. The old things look nice and the new things look modern.
D. Old songs are more pleasant than new songs.

questions.explanation: Ray 的原話是 I like both the old things and the new things. The old things look nice and the new things look modern.，所以選 C。

readingQA.title: 練習 4：閱讀理解問答題
readingQA.description: 根據課文內容，用完整的句子回答下列問題：

questions.text: 1. Does Amy like the music her parents listen to? Why?
questions.answer: Yes, she does. Because the old songs her parents listen to are quite pleasant to the ears.
variations: Yes, she does because the old songs are pleasant to the ears.
questions.explanation: Amy 說那些老歌 quite pleasant to the ears（很悅耳），而且她的父母總是聽那種音樂，所以她喜歡。

questions.text: 2. What new gadget does Karen like? Why does she like it?
questions.answer: She likes new mobile phones. Because she thinks they are great and awesome.
variations: She likes new mobile phones because they are great and awesome.
questions.explanation: Karen 說 Those new mobile phones are great... It's awesome!，她覺得新手機很棒、很厲害，所以她喜歡新手機。

questions.text: 3. Can people use both typewriters and computers to do the same thing? What is it?
questions.answer: Yes, they can. They can type letters and stories.
variations: Yes, they can type letters and stories.
questions.explanation: Ray 說 We can use both typewriters and computers to type letters and stories，所以兩者都能用來打信件和故事。

questions.text: 4. Why does Amy's grandma think her old camera is better than digital cameras?
questions.explanation: Amy 的奶奶說舊相機比數位相機更好，because its pictures look nicer，因為舊相機拍的照片看起來更漂亮。

sentencePattern.title: 練習 5：句型運用題
sentencePattern.description: 用 "both ... and ..." 句型描述下列兩組 gadget 的共同用途，完成句子：

items.before: 1. Record player and MP3 player: Both a record player and an MP3 player can be used to
items.explanation: 唱片播放機和 MP3 播放器都可以用來聽音樂，所以填 listen to music。

items.before: 2. Typewriter and computer: Both a typewriter and a computer allow people to
items.explanation: 打字機和電腦都可以用來打信件和故事，所以填 type letters and stories。

items.before: 3. Film camera and digital camera: People can
items.after: with both a film camera and a digital camera.
items.explanation: 膠片相機和數位相機都可以用來拍照，所以填 take pictures。

items.before: 4. Rotary telephone and mobile phone: We can
items.after: using both a rotary telephone and a mobile phone.
items.explanation: 轉盤電話和手機都可以用來打電話，所以填 make phone calls。

comparative.title: 練習 6：比較級與最高級運用題
comparative.description: 根據課文內容和表格信息，用形容詞的比較級 (Comparatives) 或最高級 (Superlatives) 完成句子：

items.after: (good) than digital cameras in her opinion.
items.explanation: good 的比較級是 better，句型是 A is better than B（A 比 B 好），所以填 better。

items.after: (bad) than new gadgets according to Karen.
items.explanation: bad 的比較級是 worse，句型是 A is worse than B（A 比 B 差），所以填 worse。

items.after: (bad) picture quality in the whole building.
items.explanation: bad 的最高級是 the worst，表示『最差的』，所以填 the worst。

items.before: 4. Among J-TEC, K-Star and PL3 laptops, PL3 has
items.explanation: large 的最高級是 the largest；PL3 的硬碟是 200 GB，三台中最大，所以用最高級 the largest。
long 的比較級是 longer；K-Star 的電池續航（4 小時）比 J-TEC（3 小時）長，所以填 longer。

items.before: 6. I think the newest things are
items.explanation: good 的最高級是 the best；『在所有之中最好的』用最高級，所以填 the best。

discussion.title: 練習 7：小組討論題
discussion.description: 和同學討論下列問題，用英文表達自己的觀點：

questions.text: 1. What new gadget do you like best? Why?
questions.placeholder: 請輸入你的答案（至少2個理由）
questions.reference:
參考答案： I like mobile phones best. First, I can use them to make phone calls with my family and friends easily. Second, I can play games and listen to music on them when I feel bored.
中文翻譯： 我最喜歡手機。首先，我可以輕鬆地用它和家人朋友打電話。其次，當我感到無聊時，我可以在上面玩遊戲和聽音樂。

questions.text: 2. Do you think old gadgets are still valuable? Why or why not?
questions.placeholder: 請輸入你的答案（至少2個理由）
questions.reference:
正面參考答案： Yes, I think old gadgets are still valuable. Firstly, they have historical meaning and can help us learn about the past life. Secondly, some old gadgets are well-made and still work well, such as old record players.
正面中文翻譯： 是的，我認為舊的小工具仍然有價值。首先，它們具有歷史意義，可以幫助我們了解過去的生活。其次，一些舊的小工具製作精良，仍然運作良好，例如舊的唱片播放機。

反面參考答案： No, I don't think so. For one thing, old gadgets are not as convenient as new ones. For another, they usually have worse functions compared with new gadgets.
反面中文翻譯： 不，我不這麼認為。一方面，舊的小工具不如新的方便。另一方面，與新的小工具相比，它們的功能通常較差。

questions.text: 3. Among the three laptops (J-TEC, K-Star, PL3), which one do you think is the best? Give your reasons.
questions.placeholder: 請輸入你的答案（至少2個理由）
questions.reference:
參考答案： I think PL3 is the best. First, it has the largest hard disk (200 GB) which can store more files. Second, it has the longest battery life (5 hours), so I can use it for a long time without charging.
中文翻譯： 我認為PL3是最好的。首先，它有最大的硬碟（200 GB），可以儲存更多文件。其次，它有最長的電池壽命（5小時），所以我可以長時間使用而不需要充電。

sections.title: 事實與觀點辨識題（每題 1 分）

questions.text: 1. "My grandma has an old camera." - Is this a fact or an opinion?
questions.explanation: 「My grandma has an old camera.」是課文中可以直接查證的事實，Amy 的奶奶確實有一台舊相機，所以是 Fact。

questions.text: 2. "New mobile phones are awesome." - Is this a fact or an opinion?
questions.explanation: 「New mobile phones are awesome.」是 Karen 個人的評價，屬於主觀的看法，所以是 Opinion。

sections.title: 詞彙匹配題（每題 1 分）
sections.description: 匹配單字與正確的釋義：

questions.text: 1. modern
questions.explanation: modern 的意思是『現代的』，即 new, up-to-date（新的、跟上時代的），所以選 C。

questions.text: 2. pleasant
questions.explanation: pleasant 的意思是『悅耳的、令人愉快的』，即 enjoyable, easy to like（令人愉快、容易喜歡的），所以選 B。

sections.title: 閱讀理解選擇題（每題 2 分）

questions.text: 1. Where did the children visit an exhibition?
questions.explanation: 課文第一句說 The children visited an exhibition at the Hong Kong Science Museum，孩子們參觀的是香港科學博物館，所以選 B。

questions.text: 2. Why doesn't Andy's grandpa want a new TV set?

options.text: B. The old one was a gift from his dad

questions.explanation: Andy 說 It's all because the TV set was a gift from his dad，爺爺不換新電視是因為舊電視機是爸爸送的禮物，所以選 B。

sections.title: 比較級填空題（每題 2 分）
sections.description: 用正確的比較級或最高級形式填空：

questions.explanation: good 的比較級是 better，表示『比……更好』，所以填 better。
long 的最高級是 the longest，表示『最長的』；「在我們班裡續航最長的」要用最高級，所以填 the longest。

sections.title: 句型運用題（每題 3 分）
sections.prompt: 用 "both ... and ..." 句型造一個句子：
sections.answer: I like both apples and oranges.
sections.explanation: 用 both...and... 句型連接兩個事物，例如：I like both apples and oranges.（我既喜歡蘋果也喜歡橘子。）
